run_rfdetr_stream: run an RTSP stream inference pipeline with RF-DETR model to track detections in configurable zones with dwell time
build_model_rfdetr: build an RF-DETR detection model from a checkpoint size string and device type with adjusted resolution
create_custom_sink: create a CustomSink that monitors polygon zones, tracks objects with ByteTrack, and annotates dwell time on video frames
adjust_resolution_for_model: adjust a video resolution to the nearest valid dimension for the specified RF-DETR model size
summarize_main_entry: summarize the main entry point that initializes an inference pipeline from an RTSP URL with zone-based time-in-zone tracking
